_about: W. W. Merry (1835-1918), Rector of Lincoln College, Oxford: Homer's Odyssey, Books I-XII, edited with English notes, appendices etc., with James Riddell (1823-1866), second edition revised (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1886), raw IA; Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Its companion volume, Books XIII-XXIV by D. B. Monro (1901), is on the monro shelf. Round dx (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: Selections from Herodotus (1892 printing); Homer's Odyssey Books XIII-XXIV, school edition (1882); Aristophanes, The Clouds (new edition, 1889) and The Birds (1889). Not taken: his Specimens of Greek Dialects and his Knights, Frogs and Wasps, whose scans OCR the English as Greek letters, and an Acharnians known only from a partial microfilm.  Round dz adds his Selected Fragments of Roman Poetry (1891).
